6
1 # 2 Ko 1.24; 5.20 Na yɛn a yɛne no bom yɛ adwuma no tu mo fo nso sɛ monnnye Nyankopɔn adom no kwa. 2#Yes 49.8; Luka 4.19; 4.21 Na ɔka sɛ:
Ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ mu na matie woɔ,
nkwagyeɛ da mu na maboa woɔ!
Hwɛ, ɛnnɛ ne adom berɛ; hwɛ, ɛnnɛ ne nkwagyeɛ da.
Asomafoɔ no adansedie nwoma
3Na yɛnto obiara suntidua, na wɔannya mfomsoɔ biara wɔ yɛn som ho, 4#2 Ko 4.2 na mmom nnoɔma nyinaa mu, yɛyi yɛn ho kyerɛ sɛ Nyankopɔn asomfoɔ: Boasetɔ pii mu, ahohia mu, ahokyere mu, ahometeɛ mu; 5#2 Ko 11.23-27 ɛhweɛ mu, afiaseda mu, mansotwe mu, adwuma den mu, ɛpɛsire mu, mmuada mu; 6#1 Ti 4.12 ahoteɛ mu, nimdeɛ mu, abodwokyɛre mu, ayamyɛ mu, Honhom Kronkron mu, ɔdɔ a nkontompo nni mu mu; 7#1 Ko 2.4 nokorɛ asɛnka mu, Nyankopɔn tumi mu, tenenee akodeɛ mu wɔ nifa ne benkum; 8animuonyam ne animguaseɛ mu, atenka bɔne ne atenka pa mu; sɛ asisifoɔ, nanso wɔyɛ nokwafoɔ; 9#2 Ko 4.10-11; Dwom 118.18 sɛ wɔn a wɔnnim wɔn, nanso wɔnim wɔn yie, sɛ wɔn a wɔrewuo, na hwɛ, yɛte ase; sɛ wɔn a wɔtwe wɔn aso, nanso wɔnkum wɔn; 10#Flp 4.12-13 sɛ awerɛhofoɔ, nanso wɔn ani gye daa; sɛ ahiafoɔ, nanso wɔma nnipa bebree nya wɔn ho; sɛ wɔn a wɔnni hwee, nanso wɔwɔ nnoɔma nyinaa.
Ɔdɔ ho adesrɛ
11O Korintofoɔ, yɛaka no pefee akyerɛ mo, yɛn akoma mu atrɛ. 12Ɛnyɛ yɛn mu na monsene, na mmom mo ara mo yam na monsene. 13#1 Ko 4.14 Na mo nso — meka yei kyerɛ mo sɛ mma — montrɛ mo mu saa ara mfa ntua ka.
Ɔbara wɔne abosonsomfoɔ ntam ayɔnkofa
14 # Efe 5.11 Mo ne wɔn a wɔnnye nnie ntwe kɔnnua korɔ; twaka bɛn na tenenee ne amumuyɛ wɔ? Anaasɛ ayɔnkofa bɛn na hann ne esum wɔ? 15Na koroyɛ bɛn na ɛwɔ Kristo ne Belial ntam? Anaasɛ kyɛfa bɛn na ogyidini ne deɛ ɔnnye nnie wɔ? 16#1 Ko 3.16; Lew 26.12 Na baakoyɛ bɛn na Nyankopɔn asɔrefie ne abosom wɔ? Na yɛyɛ Onyankopɔn a ɔte aseɛ no asɔrefie, sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn aka sɛ:
Mɛtena wɔn mu, na manante wɔn mu,
na mayɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn,
na wɔayɛ me man.
17 # Yes 52.11; Adi 18.4 Enti momfiri wɔn mu,
na monte mo ho mfiri wɔn mu, Awurade na ɔseɛ,
na monnka deɛ ɛyɛ fi;
na me nso magye mo,
18 # Yer 31.9; 32.38 na mayɛ mo agya,
na moayɛ me mmammarima ne mmammaa,
Awurade Tumfoɔ na ɔseɛ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na yɛn a yɛne no bom yɛ adwuma no tu mo fo nso sɛ monnnye Nyankopɔn adom no kwa. Na ɔka sɛ:
Ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ mu na matie woɔ,
nkwagyeɛ da mu na maboa woɔ!
Hwɛ, ɛnnɛ ne adom berɛ; hwɛ, ɛnnɛ ne nkwagyeɛ da.

Na yɛnto obiara suntidua, na wɔannya mfomsoɔ biara wɔ yɛn som ho, na mmom nnoɔma nyinaa mu, yɛyi yɛn ho kyerɛ sɛ Nyankopɔn asomfoɔ: Boasetɔ pii mu, ahohia mu, ahokyere mu, ahometeɛ mu; ɛhweɛ mu, afiaseda mu, mansotwe mu, adwuma den mu, ɛpɛsire mu, mmuada mu; ahoteɛ mu, nimdeɛ mu, abodwokyɛre mu, ayamyɛ mu, Honhom Kronkron mu, ɔdɔ a nkontompo nni mu mu; nokorɛ asɛnka mu, Nyankopɔn tumi mu, tenenee akodeɛ mu wɔ nifa ne benkum; animuonyam ne animguaseɛ mu, atenka bɔne ne atenka pa mu; sɛ asisifoɔ, nanso wɔyɛ nokwafoɔ; sɛ wɔn a wɔnnim wɔn, nanso wɔnim wɔn yie, sɛ wɔn a wɔrewuo, na hwɛ, yɛte ase; sɛ wɔn a wɔtwe wɔn aso, nanso wɔnkum wɔn; sɛ awerɛhofoɔ, nanso wɔn ani gye daa; sɛ ahiafoɔ, nanso wɔma nnipa bebree nya wɔn ho; sɛ wɔn a wɔnni hwee, nanso wɔwɔ nnoɔma nyinaa.

O Korintofoɔ, yɛaka no pefee akyerɛ mo, yɛn akoma mu atrɛ. Ɛnyɛ yɛn mu na monsene, na mmom mo ara mo yam na monsene. Na mo nso — meka yei kyerɛ mo sɛ mma — montrɛ mo mu saa ara mfa ntua ka.

Mo ne wɔn a wɔnnye nnie ntwe kɔnnua korɔ; twaka bɛn na tenenee ne amumuyɛ wɔ? Anaasɛ ayɔnkofa bɛn na hann ne esum wɔ? Na koroyɛ bɛn na ɛwɔ Kristo ne Belial ntam? Anaasɛ kyɛfa bɛn na ogyidini ne deɛ ɔnnye nnie wɔ? Na baakoyɛ bɛn na Nyankopɔn asɔrefie ne abosom wɔ? Na yɛyɛ Onyankopɔn a ɔte aseɛ no asɔrefie, sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn aka sɛ:
Mɛtena wɔn mu, na manante wɔn mu,
na mayɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn,
na wɔayɛ me man.
Enti momfiri wɔn mu,
na monte mo ho mfiri wɔn mu, Awurade na ɔseɛ,
na monnka deɛ ɛyɛ fi;
na me nso magye mo,
na mayɛ mo agya,
na moayɛ me mmammarima ne mmammaa,
Awurade Tumfoɔ na ɔseɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
